claim_text: Three oil tankers struck sea mines and caught fire on the southern Strait of Hormuz route in the 24 hours before October 29, 2026.

citations.quote: The Master of a third-party vessel has reported sighting another vessel on fire.
The claims have not been independently verified.
it is unclear whether that refers to vessels beyond the four confirmed

reason: The packet verifies a reported fire and documents later named tanker attacks, but does not establish three sea-mine strikes in the specified preceding 24 hours. November1 maritime analysis still cannot match Iran’s mine claim to the known incidents. A real IRGC announcement is not verification of its underlying event claim.

claim_grounding_notes: Inspected video showing a distant smoke plume over water; original X caption explicitly attributes the three-tanker account to IRGC. Caption is preserved so reporting the announcement is not mislabeled false.
date_scope_notes: Original post uploaded within October26–November2, 2026; claim evaluated as of November2. Older evidence is used only to establish prior footage provenance or background, not to assert a current event.
source_quality_notes: UKMTO is a primary incident warning, limited to a third-party sighting. Windward supplies newer vessel-level analysis; its confirmed attacks have differing timing and mechanisms. IranWire and Safety4Sea explicitly retain the verification gap. CENTCOM disagreement alone is not proof of falsity.
